facts.fact: The Observer reports that the judiciary's Electronic Court Case Management Information System (ECCMIS) is in use, with courts operating largely on digital systems and a 1 July 2026 paperless deadline set by the Chief Justice's circular.
The Observer reports that through ECCMIS lawyers and litigants can file cases and pleadings, submit documents and request hearing dates online, per the High Court deputy registrar.
The Observer reports that ULII hosts more than 41,000 decisions from the High Court, Court of Appeal, Supreme Court and tribunals, searchable online, with 350,000 users a month.
